issues.legal_issue: For an application seeking a court reference in a land acquisition matter, the period running from the Collector’s award does not begin before the award is communicated to, or actually or constructively known by, the affected person.
material_facts: The Collector made, signed, and filed an award determining compensation, but the affected owner was not present or represented when it was made.
The Collector did not give the owner notice of the award.
The owner learned of the award later and applied for a reference within six months of learning of it.
issues.conclusion: The application was not time-barred because the relevant date of the award was the date when the owner knew of it, not the earlier date when the Collector signed or filed it.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 12(1), 12(2), and 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the Collector’s award is an offer of compensation on behalf of the Government, and section 12(2) requires immediate notice to interested persons who were not present or represented when it was made. Accordingly, the expression “date of the Collector’s award” in the proviso to section 18 means the date the award is communicated to, or actually or constructively known by, the affected person. The Court applied Ezra v. The Secretary of State and Ezra v. Secretary of State for India, and approved Magdonald v. The Secretary of State for India in Council and Hari Das Pal v. The Municipal Board, Lucknow; it disapproved the contrary approach in Jehangir Bomanji v. G. D. Gaikwad and State of Travancore-Cochin v. Narayani Amma Ponnamma.

rule.if: land_acquisition_reference_application and applicant_absent_from_award and award_notice_not_given and application_within_six_months_of_award_knowledge

predicates.land_acquisition_reference_application: A person applied in a land acquisition proceeding for the compensation matter to be referred to a court.
predicates.applicant_absent_from_award: The applicant was neither present nor represented when the award was made.
predicates.award_notice_not_given: The authority did not give the applicant notice of the award after making it.
predicates.application_within_six_months_of_award_k: The applicant filed the reference application within six months after actually or constructively learning of the award.
predicates.application_not_time_barred: The reference application is not barred by the limitation period calculated from the award.

issues.definition: When an absent applicant in a land acquisition reference proceeding receives no notice of the award and applies within six months of learning of it, the application is not time-barred.
